d:
"One of my patrons, Canniballistic1, cooked up the most incredible piece of fan art I've ever seen: a fully rigged model of Ragnith, and an entire birth sequence using it. I got to be there as she was made and came to life, and I feel truly honored to have received something like this.

If you have a Pixiv or DeviantArt account please check out the original upload over there and toss him a follow! He'll be opening for commissions soon as well!

(In case you're wondering, the text in the last pic reads qvâ hudpôt, or "the end" in Ragnith's language)" - Zendrid
